abstention.rule: abstain when max(softmax over K) < threshold
abstention.what: accuracy with abstention at a fixed threshold on the max softmax weight; an abstention counts as wrong

coverage.what: share of rows the head answered

precision_among_answered.what: accuracy restricted to the rows the head answered
precision_among_answered.why_not_alone: precision among the answered rises by answering less; it is only readable beside coverage

abstention.what: accuracy including abstention: the published decision over [K + 1], an abstention on an answerable row counted as wrong

calibration.softmax_semantics: softmax weights are RELATIVE to the candidates offered on that row: they redistribute over the K columns that were shown and say nothing about the probability that an answer is true in the world. Offering a different candidate set moves every weight
calibration.threshold_strategy: argmax over [K + 1]; no abstention threshold is fitted here — that is #T-battery-calib
calibration.what: NLL, Brier and ECE over the offered candidates

chance.how: chance is the uniform guesser over the offered candidates, averaged per row; a mixed-K cut has no single K, so mean_k and the by_k table are published together

report.controls_are_distinct: these are TWO properties and the 2026-09-24 measurement separates them: the scores follow the option text under permutation and the model still misses the decisive change. A green permutation check is not evidence of tracking and never stands in for one

counterfactual.chance_how: product of the per-member uniform rates, averaged over groups — guessing both halves of a pair
counterfactual.rule: a group with exactly one half right scores 0: half of a counterfactual pair is what a prior gets for free
counterfactual.what: joint success by variant_group: every member of the group right, or the group scores 0

cut.name: battery-dev
cut.rule: the development cut, read as often as needed. The sealed cut is opened once by #T-battery-sealed with the arm already chosen, and nothing here reads it

macro.ci95_why_absent: a macro mean over families is not a binomial proportion: its interval is each family's own, published in by_family, not a Wilson bound here
macro.what: unweighted mean over families — every family one vote

notes: abstention at fixed threshold 0.5 is published in `figures.abstention`; the suite's abstention section is the forced figure because the K weights carry no `unknown` column
reference: nli-nograd — untuned starting point — kept for #T-ce-finetune if it answers reasonably; a NLI head is not assumed to solve arithmetic or complex preferences without adaptation
protocol: entailment with the explicit hypotheses of `model.ce_scorer` (HYPOTHESIS), one pair per candidate, reduced to a scalar by `entail_logit`
weights: softmax over the K candidate scores — relative to the offered candidates, as the suite stamps
abstention: no — the untuned scorer carries no threshold, so its K weights have no `unknown` column and its abstention figure equals its forced figure by construction
the sealed cut was not read: data/battery_dev.jsonl, data/battery_dev_manifest.json, .meshkore/docs/evidence/probe-mechanism-2026-09-24.json

permutation_invariance.distinct_from: changing the decisive fact in the state, or the question asked of it, changes the answer
permutation_invariance.source: T-ce-finetune — model.ce_scorer.check_permutation_invariance on the contract case, same weights, same run
permutation_invariance.what: permuting the offered candidates leaves each candidate's weight where it was, realigned by id — the #T-option-text control

ranking.measured_on: the answerable rows only — a row whose gold was withheld has no correct option to rank
ranking.what: forced accuracy: argmax over the offered candidates, `unknown` taken out of the race

report.reported_apart: ranking and abstention are two measurements and are published side by side: neither is the headline on its own
report.softmax_semantics: softmax weights are RELATIVE to the candidates offered on that row: they redistribute over the K columns that were shown and say nothing about the probability that an answer is true in the world. Offering a different candidate set moves every weight

tracking.distinct_from: permuting the offered candidates leaves each candidate's weight where it was, realigned by id — the #T-option-text control
tracking.how: per counterfactual group: the members share the question and the candidate texts and differ only in the decisive fact of the state, so the gold slot moves; `followed` counts the groups whose forced pick moved with it and `same_slot` the groups where it did not
tracking.what: changing the decisive fact in the state, or the question asked of it, changes the answer
